intent: Build the self-evolution loop: a 30-day cycle that observes how coco's skills and personas are actually used, proposes evidence-backed edits as branches and pull requests, and lands nothing without the owner's merge. Close out the team-gate retrofit that PR #196 carries so the gates that certify work are enforced rather than described, including the three deny runs now unblocked by the per-guard hook flag. Scale the persona roster toward a thousand entries through bulk generation that keeps every count gate green.
